block.bloodandbones.backtank_port.toolti: _Crouch_ next to it with a _Port Arm_ and a backtank on to plug in: to the pipes, the port _is_ your tank. Pump into it to fill, out of it to empty.
A _port_ for a worn Fluid Backtank, like a pump with a direction. Pipes connect to its _nozzle_.
block.bloodandbones.beheader.tooltip.beh: Takes the _head_ off in one stroke.
Zombies, skeletons, creepers and piglins sometimes leave their _skull_ whole. A wither skeleton's rarely survives.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.
block.bloodandbones.beheader.tooltip.sum: A spinning saw at neck height. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.bleeding_rack.toolti: Catches the blood of a carcass hung up to _8 blocks_ above it.
A carcass lying still _on_ the rack drains too, at half the speed.
An _Encased Fan_ blowing across the body drains it up to _four times_ faster.
Pipes pull blood from its _sides and bottom_. When it is full, the carcass stops draining. A _bled_ carcass rots slower.
A copper _drip tray_ with a tank for catching _blood_.
block.bloodandbones.blood_trough.tooltip: Takes _four buckets_ of any blood, from a bucket, a _Spout_ or _pipes_ on any side.
A trough of _blood_ for flesh minions: they walk to the nearest one they can reach and drink when they run low.
_Fill_ a Brass Casing with 250 mB of blood using a _Spout_.
Brass casing _splashed with blood_. Joins up with its neighbours like any casing.
block.bloodandbones.bloody_casing.toolti: _Fill_ an Andesite Casing with 250 mB of blood using a _Spout_.
Andesite casing _smeared with blood_, for a slaughterhouse that looks the part. Joins up with its neighbours like any casing.
block.bloodandbones.bloody_copper_casing: _Fill_ a Copper Casing with 250 mB of blood using a _Spout_.
Copper casing _splashed with blood_. Joins up with its neighbours like any casing.
block.bloodandbones.bone_pile.tooltip.be: Adds a _layer_, up to a full block.
block.bloodandbones.bone_pile.tooltip.co: When Used on a Bone Pile
block.bloodandbones.bone_pile.tooltip.su: Bones _heaped in layers_, as snow lies. A thin scatter can be walked through.
block.bloodandbones.butcher_hook.tooltip: Hangs it on the hook. It _keeps_ there. R-Click with an _empty hand_ to take it down.
When R-Clicked with a Carcass Piece
A hook for a wall, to hang a carcass piece on for show.
block.bloodandbones.butcher_table.toolti: _Chops_ the piece apart into meat, bone, offal and fat, spoiled as far as it had rotted.
When R-Clicked with a Carcass Piece
When R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
A steel table for cutting up carcass pieces by hand.
block.bloodandbones.charging_cradle.tool: Swaps a full _Soul Canister_ into any brass minion beside it that is running low or has powered down, and keeps the empty. With _brass sheets_ it mends one docked there.
Full canisters and sheets go in, empties come out. By hand: R-Click with a canister or sheet to put it in, with an empty hand to take the empties.
Where _brass minions_ get fresh soul blood. Needs a shaft from below turning at _16 RPM_ or more; the faster, the quicker the swap.
block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.beh: Skins it a stroke at a time: _hide_ and, from a sheep, _wool_ into its output.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.
block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.sum: Spiked rollers that strip the _hide_ off a carcass. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.guillotine.tooltip.b: Takes the nearest _limb_ off in one stroke. It never takes the head.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.
block.bloodandbones.guillotine.tooltip.s: A heavy blade on two posts. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.gut_chain.tooltip.be: Three pieces of _offal_ in a column make three.
_Hangs_ a link from the chain, to ride it round and swing. R-Click the hanging string to add links, up to _eight_. _Hit_ it to take it down.
block.bloodandbones.gut_chain.tooltip.co: When R-Clicked on a Chain Conveyor
block.bloodandbones.gut_chain.tooltip.su: A string of _guts_, hung like a chain. Squelches underfoot and in the hand.
block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.beha: Tears the _limbs_ off, then grinds every piece into meat, bone, offal and fat.
Keeps what it makes _inside_: take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a _funnel_, chute or hopper. When full, it stops.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.
block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.summ: Teeth and rollers that tear a carcass _apart_ and grind it down. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.ribcage_arch.tooltip: Faces you, so a stack built from inside the arch bends towards you. Placed against another rib, it _lines up_ with it.
A segment of _giant rib_, wet and bloody at the joints. Stacked, ribs rise straight; the top one _bends in_; ribs hung in the air beside it run level, the _crown_ of the arch.
block.bloodandbones.shackle_hook.tooltip: Hangs the carcass you are dragging by the _neck_, belly facing out, swinging. Click again to let it down.
A hung carcass never _settles_, can be worked from every side, and _bleeds_ into a Bleeding Rack below.
When R-Clicked with a Meat Hook
A hook on a chain for _hanging_ carcasses. Mount it under a ceiling or on a wall.
block.bloodandbones.specimen_jar.tooltip: Puts it in, to drift in the fluid; a carcass piece pickles pale. R-Click with an _empty hand_ to take it out.
A jar of cloudy _preserving fluid_ for keeping _one item_ on show, any item.
block.bloodandbones.spit_roast.tooltip.b: _Skewers_ it. It roasts only while the spit _turns_ and there is _heat_ below: a campfire, fire, lava or a Blaze Burner. Hotter and faster cooks quicker.
Takes it off: raw, it comes back as it was; _browned_, it comes apart into cooked meat and bones. Left twice as long, it _burns_ to charcoal.
block.bloodandbones.spit_roast.tooltip.c: When R-Clicked with a Carcass Piece
When R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
block.bloodandbones.spit_roast.tooltip.s: Posts and a turning _spit_ for roasting carcass pieces over a fire.
block.bloodandbones.steel_rack.tooltip.b: Puts the held item on the place you are _looking at_, one item a place.
Takes back the thing you are looking at. Funnels and hoppers fill it from the _lower left_.
block.bloodandbones.steel_rack.tooltip.c: When R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
block.bloodandbones.steel_rack.tooltip.s: Cold steel _shelves_ to show parts on: two shelves, _two places_ on each.
Lays the held item on it: _one item_, any item. A carcass piece lies on its back.
Takes it back. A _funnel_ or _hopper_ can lay things on it and take them off.
When R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
A cold steel _morgue table_. Tables side by side _join into one run_, with legs only where it ends or turns.
block.bloodandbones.surgery_table.toolti: Lays it on the table: a _Cleaver_ takes a limb off (a player's only with a _surgeon minion_ at the table), a _prosthetic_ or a _severed limb_ goes where one is missing.
You _lie down_ on it and choose which part to operate on. _Sneak_ to get up.
Takes back what lies on the table.
R-Click with an _empty hand_ to operate on them: another player, or a _mob_ you led onto it on a lead. What comes out is yours.
R-Click with a _Cleaver_ to take its _organs_ out, one a cut: a body's heart, lungs and stomach, a head's eyes.

With an _Assembly Frame_ fitted, lay a carcass _torso_ on it (or R-Click with an empty hand to take a whole carcass lying on it), then R-Click with carcass _heads_, _legs_, _arms_ and _tails_ of any mob to stitch them on. A _Cleaver_ takes the last back off; a bucket of _blood_ wakes it.
When R-Clicked with a Blade, Implant or Limb
When R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
When Sneak-R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
With a Carcass Piece on It
A padded table with straps. What it does depends on its _attachment_: a _Surgical Rig_ to operate (have a limb _off_, or a new one _on_; nothing can go wrong), an _Assembly Frame_ to build minions.

bloodandbones.configuration.bloodless_mo: Hides blood drops and stains, draws skinned carcasses pale, the machines and hooks clean and blood brown. A server can force it on for everyone with the bloodandbonesBloodless game rule.
bloodandbones.configuration.crumble_afte: How long a rotten carcass lasts before it falls apart, in Minecraft days of 20 minutes, counted at the rot speed.
bloodandbones.configuration.disabled_eff: Trait effect types that do nothing on this server, by id, such as bloodandbones:teleport. Traits that use them keep their other effects.
bloodandbones.configuration.presentation: How blood and gore look. Nothing here changes how the game plays.
bloodandbones.configuration.rot.tooltip: How carcasses rot and what becomes of them.
bloodandbones.configuration.rot_speed.to: How fast carcasses rot: 1 is normal, 2 twice as fast, 0 never.
bloodandbones.configuration.rotten_carca: A carcass left rotten falls apart into bones and a little rotten flesh, so old ones do not pile up.
bloodandbones.configuration.trait_streng: Trait amounts (attribute changes, damage changes, heals, pushes, damage dealt) are multiplied by this: 1 is normal, 0 takes them away.
bloodandbones.configuration.traits.toolt: The traits of carcass armour and minions.

bloodandbones.implant.runs_on_any: Runs on whatever is in the tank, a shot at a time
bloodandbones.jei.backtank.1: The Fluid Backtank holds any fluid, worn in the chest slot with the armour of its tier: copper 2 buckets, gold 3, iron 4, diamond 6, blood steel 8, blood diamond 16, soul netherite 32.
bloodandbones.jei.backtank.2: Right-click a block to set it down; pipes fill or empty it from any side, and it keeps its fluid when broken. A Spout fills it and an Item Drain empties it in the hand. The soul netherite tank is a smithing upgrade of the blood diamond one.
bloodandbones.jei.backtank.3: Crafted with a carcass chestplate, it straps onto the chestplate's back, fluid and all: worn, it is your tank, and the chestplate has the better armour of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off again.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.1: Put a Bleeding Rack under a Shackle Hook (up to 8 blocks below) and hang a carcass: its blood drips into the tray. A carcass lying still on the rack drains too, more slowly.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.2: A cow holds about a bucket. Encased Fans blowing across the body drain it up to four times faster. Pipe the blood out of the sides or bottom.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.1: Bigger pieces give more: meat and bone come from every part by its size, offal and fat from the body.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.2: Fresh meat is whole. Half-rotten meat gives half. Badly rotten meat turns to rotten flesh, and a rotten carcass has no hide worth taking. Cold slows rot, ice stops it, and a bled carcass keeps longer.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.1: Carcass armour is made of scraps from the Mangler. Five head scraps of one mob make a helmet, four leg scraps boots. A chestplate is six torso scraps with two arm scraps of any one mob on top (the shoulders); leggings are four leg scraps with three tail scraps of any one mob, or more legs, on top (the hips). A mob with no bone of a kind uses its torso scraps there.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.2: Craft a piece with one thing to fit it: hides of one mob (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) for its hide traits; an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table (eyes in a helmet, a heart or lungs in a chestplate, a stomach in a chestplate or leggings) for its organ traits. What it replaces comes back.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.3: Tiers, in order: a Blood Steel Ingot, then a Blood Diamond, then a Soul Netherite Ingot, each giving more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Mechanical Crafters fit hides, organs and tiers too, but only where nothing comes back out.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.1: The Cleaver takes a carcass apart. Right-click a limb three times to cut through the joint; it comes free as a piece of its own that can be hooked, carried, hung or butchered.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.2: Three more cuts on a loose piece butcher it into meat and bone. The body is butchered last, once nothing hangs off it; it gives the offal and fat.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.1: Bloody Casing: fill an Andesite Casing with 250 mB of blood from a Spout. It joins up with its neighbours like Create's own casings. Brass and Copper Casings take blood the same way.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.2: Gut Chain: three pieces of offal in a column make three. It hangs and lies like a chain. Used on a Create chain conveyor's chain, it hangs a link from it that rides round with the chain; use more on the string to lengthen it, up to eight links, and hit it to take it down.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.3: Ribcage Arch: build two stacks facing each other; the top of each bends inward, and ribs hung in the air between them run level to close the arch. A row of arches makes the inside of a ribcage. Bone Pile: use it on a pile to add a layer; each layer drops two bones.
bloodandbones.jei.display.1: Show off your work. The Butcher's Hook hangs on the side of a solid block and the Specimen Jar sits anywhere; either holds one carcass piece, which keeps there. Right-click with the piece, and with an empty hand to take it back.
bloodandbones.jei.display.2: The Butcher's Table holds a piece too, lying on its top: right-click it with a Cleaver and it comes apart into meat, bone, offal and fat, spoiled as far as it had rotted.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.1: The Flensing Knife takes the hide off. Four strokes on any part of a carcass and the whole hide drops, with a sheep's wool, a mooshroom's mushrooms or a rabbit's pelt as it applies.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.2: Skin before you butcher: a piece cut down with its hide still on loses it. Rot spoils hides.
bloodandbones.jei.implants.1: Basic prosthetics (Peg Leg, Hook Hand) need nothing. Organic ones (Flesh Arm, Sinew Leg, Furnace Stomach) run on blood and cybernetics (Hydraulic Arm, Piston Leg, Optic Eye, Pump Heart, Bellows Lungs) on soul blood, from a worn Fluid Backtank, a mB or two a second. The Vent Arm runs on whatever the tank holds; the Port Arm needs nothing.
bloodandbones.jei.implants.2: When the tank runs out of their fluid they stop working, as if the part were missing, until it is filled again. The Vent Arm sprays the tank (hold use, empty-handed); the Port Arm plugs the tank into pipes at a Backtank Port.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.1: The Mangler, Guillotine, Beheader and Deglover work any carcass lying on or hanging over them. Each takes a shaft from below; the faster it turns, the faster it works. Set them flush in a floor so a body lies across them.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.2: Guillotine: limbs off. Beheader: heads off, sometimes a skull. Deglover: hides off. Mangler: everything, down to meat and bone. Take their output with a funnel or an empty hand.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.3: The filter slot on each machine's top edge picks what it works on: a spawn egg or a carcass piece for one kind of mob, or a Create list or attribute filter.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.1: The Meat Hook is where a carcass comes from. Kill an animal or monster with it and the whole body stays behind as a ragdoll you can hook, drag, hang, cut up and process, instead of its loot.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.2: Right-click a limb to hook it and drag the body behind you. Heavier animals slow you down more. Right-click again to let go. What the mob was carrying (saddles, chests, armour, held items) still drops.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.1: Fit an Assembly Frame to a Surgery Table and lay a carcass torso on it, or take a whole carcass lying on it with an empty hand (what is still attached comes along). Stitch on heads, legs, arms and tails of any mob, one a click: a cow on rabbit legs is a cow that hops. A Cleaver takes the last piece back. Wake it with a bucket of blood.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.2: Every part does its own thing. The torso sets its size, health and how much it carries; the head its jobs and its bite; the legs how fast and how it moves; arms its blows. Crouch and R-Click it with an empty hand to change its job.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.3: It runs on blood: a little all the time, more moving, working and fighting. Low, it walks to a Blood Trough to drink. Empty, it lies down where it is, alive, and nothing but a player can hurt it; give it blood and it gets up. Crouch-R-Click one lying down a few times to fold it up and carry it.
bloodandbones.jei.morgue.1: The Steel Table holds one item, any item, on its top. Tables side by side join into one run, with legs only where the run ends or turns. Funnels and hoppers can load it.
bloodandbones.jei.morgue.2: The Steel Rack has two shelves of two places. Right-click its front with an item on the place you are looking at; an empty hand takes it back. Funnels and hoppers fill it from the lower left.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.1: Mount the Shackle Hook under a ceiling or on a wall. Drag a carcass close and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it by the neck.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.2: To send a carcass down a line, drag it under a Create chain conveyor and right-click the chain with the Meat Hook: it rides the chain on a trolley, round wheels and along strands, and stops at frogports addressed for it.
bloodandbones.jei.soul_blood.1: Soul Blood is blood with a soul in it. Mix blood, soul sand and a little liquid experience over a superheated Blaze Burner, or ferment blood with nether wart and soul soil under a Basin Lid.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.1: Amputation is a ritual: lay a Cleaver on the Surgery Table (with its Surgical Rig), have a surgeon minion (one with a villager's or a pillager's head, and an arm) awake beside it, and lie on the table (right-click with an empty hand) to have one of your own limbs, eyes or organs taken out. You get it back, with your name on it. Nothing takes a part any other way, and nothing can go wrong.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.2: The surgeon hacks: what it takes off leaves a ragged stump, and fitting anything there later takes a bucket of blood as well (from a bucket or a Fluid Backtank you carry). Swap an implant straight in for a part of flesh and there is no stump at all.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.3: A missing arm means no off-hand and slower swings, a missing leg no sprinting, a missing eye less to see by. Lay an implant or a part on the table and lie down again to fit it; an implant unclips with nothing on the table. Fitting never needs a surgeon, so a crude prosthetic can always go on.

bloodless.block.bloodandbones.ribcage_ar: A segment of _giant rib_, bleached clean. Stacked, ribs rise straight; the top one _bends in_; ribs hung in the air beside it run level, the _crown_ of the arch.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.backtank.3: Crafted with a plated chestplate, it straps onto the chestplate's back, fluid and all: worn, it is your tank, and the chestplate has the better armour of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off again.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armo: Plated armour is made of salvage from the Mangler. Five pieces of head salvage from one mob make a helmet, four of leg salvage boots. A chestplate is six of torso salvage with two of arm salvage from any one mob on top (the shoulders); leggings are four of leg salvage with three of tail salvage from any one mob, or more legs, on top (the hips). A mob with no bone of a kind uses its torso salvage there.

Craft a piece with one thing to fit it: coverings of one mob (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) for its covering traits; a core taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table (lenses in a helmet, a pump or bellows in a chestplate, a hopper in a chestplate or leggings) for its core traits. What it replaces comes back.

Tiers, in order: an Essence Steel Ingot, then an Essence Diamond, then a Soul Netherite Ingot, each giving more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Mechanical Crafters fit coverings, cores and tiers too, but only where nothing comes back out.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.carcass_boo: Craft it with _coverings of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _covering traits_. A new covering replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with an _Essence Steel Ingot_, then an _Essence Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _salvage_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.

Craft it with a _pump_, _bellows_ or a _hopper_ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table, as its _core_, to add that mob's _core traits_. One core a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.

bloodless.item.bloodandbones.eye.tooltip: Goes back in where a lens is _missing_. A lens gone closes in your _view_; with none you see only a few blocks.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.heart.toolt: _Swaps_ in for a pump. A pump is never taken out alone; one that stops (a dry Pump Heart) leaves you _weak and slow_, but alive.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.lungs.toolt: Go back in where bellows are _missing_. Without working bellows you cannot sprint.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.scraps.name: %s %s Salvage
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.scraps.tool: Salvage of one mob makes _plated armour_: head salvage a helmet, torso salvage a chestplate, leg salvage leggings and boots. The mob decides the armour's material and its _traits_.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.stomach.too: Goes back in where a hopper is _missing_. Without a working hopper you cannot eat, though you never starve.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.blood_scen: You sense anything below half its health within 16 blocks, through walls, and see it spark.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.echo_sense: Every 5 seconds a sharp click shows you the creatures within 16 blocks (24 at II), through walls. A minion hunts by it through walls.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.roar.desc: Core Ability: a grinding roar that throws everything within 4 blocks back and slows it. Every 20 seconds.
gamerule.bloodandbonesBloodless.descript: Hides blood, gore and wet textures for every player, whatever their own setting. Carcasses and machines work the same.
item.bloodandbones.analytical_lens.toolt: Counts as Create's _goggles_. Looking at a machine _through walls_, you read its speed, its network's stress and what goggles would tell you. Costs a little soul blood, all the time.
An _eye module_: a ground lens with a brass iris.
item.bloodandbones.assembly_frame.toolti: Fits it (swapping out any other attachment). Then a carcass _torso_ laid on it can be built into a minion, with the heads, legs and arms of _any_ mob.
An empty hand takes it back off.
When R-Clicked on a Surgery Table
When Sneak-R-Clicked off an Empty Table
A Surgery Table _attachment_: clamps and a jig for stitching bodies together. Makes the table a place to build _minions_.
item.bloodandbones.barometric_vent.toolt: A puff of lift, then a slow _hover_ down: a second on a tap, a few seconds at full spool. Crouch to drop.
A _leg module_: a pressure vent in the heel.
item.bloodandbones.bellows_lungs.tooltip: You breathe _underwater_. Dry, you are too winded to sprint.
_Cybernetic_ lungs, a pair of bellows. Run on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.blood_diamond.tooltip: A diamond steeped in _soul blood_. Fill a diamond with _1000 mB_ of soul blood in a Spout.
item.bloodandbones.blood_diamond_fluid_b: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _16 buckets_ and gives the armour of blood diamond.
item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_cleaver.t: Takes a limb off, or butchers a piece, in _two_ chops instead of three.
A cleaver of _blood steel_. Every chop goes _twice as deep_.
item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_fluid_bac: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _8 buckets_ and gives the armour of blood steel.
item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_ingot.too: Iron _quenched in blood_. Fill an iron ingot with _250 mB_ of blood in a Spout.
item.bloodandbones.brass_sheathing.toolt: Sheathes it. Then a _Soul Canister_ wakes it as a brass minion: slower to drain, immune to poison and drowning, but it never heals itself.
When R-Clicked on a Brass Frame
Brass plates for a frame of _skinned_ carcass pieces on the Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_boots.tooltip: Every mob's parts do something different: _mix_ them freely. A full set from _one_ mob adds that mob's bonus, and its drawback.
Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_chestplate.to: Every mob's parts do something different: _mix_ them freely. A full set from _one_ mob adds that mob's bonus, and its drawback.
Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _heart_, _lungs_ or a _stomach_ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table to add that mob's _organ traits_. One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.

Craft it with a _Fluid Backtank_ to strap the tank on its back: prosthetics run on it as if it were worn, Spouts and Item Drains fill and empty it, and the armour is the better of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off; if the chestplate breaks or burns, the tank falls free.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.

Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with an _eye_ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table to add that mob's _organ traits_. One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.

Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _stomach_ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table to add that mob's _organ traits_. One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_piece.tooltip: Picks a _loose_ piece up off the ground. Pieces still attached have to be cut off first.
Puts it back down as a _body_ again.
It can be _roasted_, or kept on _show_.
When Shift-R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
On a Spit Roast or in a Specimen Jar
A piece of carcass light enough to _carry_: a head, a leg, or a whole small animal.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.behav: _Cuts_ into the joint. Three cuts and the limb comes off as a piece of its own.
_Butchers_ it: three cuts and it falls apart into meat, bone and, from the body, offal and fat.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.condi: When R-Clicked on a Loose Piece
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.summa: A heavy blade for taking a carcass _apart_. Slow in a fight, but it goes through bone.
item.bloodandbones.copper_fluid_backtank: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _2 buckets_ and gives the armour of copper.
item.bloodandbones.crude_heart.tooltip.b: It beats like your own. A heart is only ever _swapped_, never taken out, so keep one of these by the table.
item.bloodandbones.crude_heart.tooltip.s: A _crude prosthetic_ heart: a leather pump on an iron frame. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.crude_lungs.tooltip.b: You breathe, and _sprint_, as you did.
item.bloodandbones.crude_lungs.tooltip.s: _Crude prosthetic_ lungs: two leather bags on a bone frame. Need nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.crude_stomach.tooltip: A _crude prosthetic_ stomach: a leather sack in an iron cage. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.diamond_fluid_backtan: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _6 buckets_ and gives the armour of diamond.
item.bloodandbones.dormant_minion.toolti: Sets it down there, still out of blood. Give it _blood_ to wake it.
A minion that ran out of blood, _folded up_ to carry. It keeps everything: what it is built of, its job, what it carries.
item.bloodandbones.empty_soul_canister.t: A _Spout_ fills it with a bucket's worth of soul blood; an _Item Drain_ empties it again.
A brass canister with a glass window, for _soul blood_ to animate a _brass minion_.
item.bloodandbones.eye.tooltip.behaviour: Goes back in where an eye is _missing_. An eye gone closes in your _view_; with none you see only a few blocks.
item.bloodandbones.flensing_knife.toolti: _Skins_ it: four strokes take the whole hide off, and a sheep's wool with it. The carcass shows _bare meat_ afterwards.
Skin _first_: a piece butchered with its hide on loses the hide. A rotting hide is poorer; a rotten one is gone.
A curved knife for taking the _hide_ off in one piece.
item.bloodandbones.flesh_arm.tooltip.beh: Blocks break _30%_ faster and it hits _harder_. When the tank runs dry it hangs _dead_, as good as no arm.
Every swing _rots_ it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go; fully rotted, it gives no bonus until it has been _perfused_.
item.bloodandbones.flesh_arm.tooltip.sum: An _organic_ arm of meat and sinew, stitched on. Runs on _blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.furnace_stomach.toolt: Nothing you eat makes you _sick_: no hunger, no poison. Dry, you cannot eat (but you do not starve).
Every meal rots it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go.
An _organic_ stomach with a fire in it. Runs on _blood_.
item.bloodandbones.glass_eye.tooltip.beh: You _see_ as you did. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.glass_eye.tooltip.sum: A _crude prosthetic_ eye of glass and iron. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.gold_fluid_backtank.t: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _3 buckets_ and gives the armour of gold.
item.bloodandbones.grappling_spool.toolt: Fires the hook where you look, further the longer you spooled. A _light_ thing is reeled in to you; anything _heavy_ (a wall, a big mob, a heavy carcass) reels _you_ in to it. Choose what you hook: a wall at speed hurts.
An _arm module_: a barbed hook on a reel of cable.
item.bloodandbones.gyroscopic_stabilizer: Takes _no fall damage_, paying soul blood for every block fallen past the safe distance. What the tank cannot pay for, you take: check your gauge before you step off.
A _leg module_: a spinning gyroscope in the shin.
item.bloodandbones.heart.tooltip.behavio: _Swaps_ in for a heart. A heart is never taken out alone; one that stops (a dry Pump Heart) leaves you _weak and slow_, but alive.
item.bloodandbones.hook_hand.tooltip.beh: The arm works as it did: the _off-hand_ and full-speed swings come back. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.hook_hand.tooltip.sum: A _crude prosthetic_ arm: an iron hook on a leather cuff. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.hydraulic_arm.tooltip: Blocks break _80%_ faster, it hits _much_ harder, and it reaches a block further. Dry, it stops.
Takes _2 arm modules_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
A _cybernetic_ arm of brass and blood steel. Runs on _soul blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.iron_fluid_backtank.t: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _4 buckets_ and gives the armour of iron.
item.bloodandbones.lungs.tooltip.behavio: Go back in where lungs are _missing_. Without working lungs you cannot sprint.
item.bloodandbones.magnet_coil.tooltip.b: Loose items and experience _drift_ to you from a few blocks.
Pulls from further the longer it is held. Near the top it takes hold of _carcasses_ too.
item.bloodandbones.magnet_coil.tooltip.s: An _arm module_: a coil of copper round the forearm.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.beh: _Hooks_ the limb you clicked and _drags_ the body behind you. Heavier animals slow you more. R-Click again to let go.
Hangs the carcass you are dragging _by the neck_.
Hangs the carcass you are dragging on a _trolley_ that rides the chain.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.con: When R-Clicked on a Shackle Hook
When R-Clicked on a Chain Conveyor
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.sum: The butcher's first tool. Anything _killed_ with it is left behind as a whole _physics carcass_ instead of dropping loot.
item.bloodandbones.optic_eye.tooltip.beh: You see in the _dark_. Dry, it sees nothing.
Takes _1 eye module_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
item.bloodandbones.optic_eye.tooltip.sum: A _cybernetic_ eye with a red lens. Runs on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.peg_leg.tooltip.behav: The leg works as it did: you can _sprint_ again. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.peg_leg.tooltip.summa: A _crude prosthetic_ leg of iron, leather and bone. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.piston_leg.tooltip.be: Walks faster, jumps _far_ higher and lands soft. Dry, it stops.
Takes _2 leg modules_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
item.bloodandbones.piston_leg.tooltip.su: A _cybernetic_ leg on a piston. Runs on _soul blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.piston_ram.tooltip.be: Strikes what you look at with _knockback_ that grows with the spool. Looking down at the ground, it _launches_ you instead. Pair it with a _Gyroscopic Stabilizer_ for the landing.
item.bloodandbones.piston_ram.tooltip.su: An _arm module_: a piston behind the knuckles.
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.beha: Plugs your worn tank into the _pipes_: pump into the port to fill it, out of it to empty it.
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.cond: Crouching Next to a Backtank Port
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.summ: A _cybernetic_ arm with a pipe coupling for a hand. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.pump_heart.tooltip.be: It keeps _healing_ you. Dry, it barely beats: you are _weak and slow_ until it has soul blood again.
item.bloodandbones.pump_heart.tooltip.su: A _cybernetic_ heart, a brass pump. Runs on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.rotational_coupler.to: Look at the end of a machine's shaft and the shaft reaches out and _drives_ it: 16 RPM on a tap, up to 256 RPM at full spool, with stress capacity to match. Let go and it pulls back.
An _arm module_: a telescoping shaft in the forearm.
item.bloodandbones.scraps.tooltip.behavi: Scraps of one mob make _carcass armour_: head scraps a helmet, torso scraps a chestplate, leg scraps leggings and boots. The mob decides the armour's material and its _traits_.
item.bloodandbones.scraps.tooltip.summar: What the _Mangler_ grinds a piece of carcass into, keeping which _mob_ and which _part_ it was.
item.bloodandbones.severed_arm.tooltip.b: Goes back on where an arm is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It is flesh again.
item.bloodandbones.severed_arm.tooltip.s: Somebody's _arm_, taken off on a Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.severed_leg.tooltip.b: Goes back on where a leg is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It is flesh again.
item.bloodandbones.severed_leg.tooltip.s: Somebody's _leg_, taken off on a Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.sinew_leg.tooltip.beh: Walks a little faster and jumps _higher_. When the tank runs dry it is _dead weight_.
Every stretch you _run_ rots it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go; fully rotted, it gives no bonus.
item.bloodandbones.sinew_leg.tooltip.sum: An _organic_ leg, all muscle. Runs on _blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.soul_canister.tooltip: Swaps into it, and the empty comes back. On the Surgery Table it wakes a sheathed brass frame.
When Used on a Brass Minion
A canister of _soul blood_: a brass minion's power.
item.bloodandbones.soul_netherite_fluid_: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _32 buckets_ and gives the armour of soul netherite.
_Sequenced assembly_: fill a netherite ingot with 1000 mB of soul blood, then press a _super experience block_ into it with a Deployer.
item.bloodandbones.stomach.tooltip.behav: Goes back in where a stomach is _missing_. Without a working stomach you cannot eat, though you never starve.
Fits it (swapping out any other attachment). Then patients can lie on the table, and carcass pieces give up their _organs_.
An empty hand takes it back off.
When R-Clicked on a Surgery Table
When Sneak-R-Clicked off an Empty Table
A Surgery Table _attachment_: an overhead arm of lamps, clamps and blades. Makes the table a place to _operate_.
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.beha: Sprays the tank ahead of you: _lava_ or fuel burns, _water_ puts fires out, _liquid experience_ gives experience, _milk_ clears effects, anything else spills.
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.cond: When Use Is Held with an Empty Hand
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.summ: A _cybernetic_ arm that ends in a nozzle. Runs on _whatever is in the tank_, and sprays it.
itemGroup.bloodandbones.title: Create: Blood & Bones
trait.bloodandbones.beloved.desc: Golems trust you and come to your defence: whatever hurts you within 16 blocks, or whatever you fight, they go for.
trait.bloodandbones.blood_scent.desc: You smell out anything below half its health within 16 blocks, through walls, and see it drip.
trait.bloodandbones.cat_terror.desc: Within 8 blocks of a cat or an ocelot you cower: Slowness II and Weakness.
trait.bloodandbones.dead_face.desc: Zombies take you for one of their own and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.echo_sense.desc: Every 5 seconds a wet click shows you the creatures within 16 blocks (24 at II), through walls. A minion hunts by it through walls.
trait.bloodandbones.ender_calm.desc: Endermen take no notice of it, even looked at. One it hurts fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.fatigue_aura.desc: Once a minute, hostile creatures within 16 blocks get Mining Fatigue II.
trait.bloodandbones.glow_aura.desc: Hostile creatures within 8 blocks glow, for everyone to see.
trait.bloodandbones.golem_trust.desc: Iron and snow golems trust you, whatever the villagers say of you. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.horde_call.desc: Hurt, and your minions and every zombie within 16 blocks turn on whatever did it.
trait.bloodandbones.item_magnet.desc: Loose items within 5 blocks hop to you (7 at II, 9 at III).
trait.bloodandbones.luminous.desc: The piece glows in the dark, as a glow squid does. A minion shines from head to foot.
trait.bloodandbones.pack_hunter.desc: 15% more damage for each ally within 8 blocks, up to 3: your minions, your pets and any wolf or fox.
trait.bloodandbones.piglin_kin.desc: Piglins and their brutes take you for one of their own, gold or no gold. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.play_dead.desc: Below a quarter health, a hit sets you playing dead: Regeneration II, and hostile creatures within 16 blocks lose you for 5 seconds. Once a minute.
trait.bloodandbones.purr.desc: Every 10 seconds, your minions and pets within 4 blocks get Regeneration I.
trait.bloodandbones.raider_kin.desc: Illagers, witches and ravagers take you for one of the raid and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.roar.desc: Organ Ability: a slobbering roar that throws everything within 4 blocks back and slows it. Every 20 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.skeleton_kin.desc: Skeletons take you for one of their own and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.spectral_sight.desc: Invisible creatures within 16 blocks show as outlines, and a minion sees them as plain as day.
trait.bloodandbones.toxin_puff.desc: Anything not on your side that comes within 2 blocks is poisoned.
trait.bloodandbones.tremor_sense.desc: You feel anything moving within 16 blocks through the ground, through walls. Still or sneaking things go unfelt. A minion hunts by it through walls.
trait.bloodandbones.warped_dread.desc: Within 7 blocks of a warped fungus you shrink back: Slowness and Weakness.
trait.bloodandbones.wide_eyes.desc: A warning, and which way to look, whenever something within 12 blocks sets its sights on you.
trait.bloodandbones.wither_aura.desc: Anything not on your side within 4 blocks withers.
